hero.pill: For hotels · Energy partner of hospitality
hero.h1: Lemnion is the energy partner for hotels.
hero.lead: With energy storage, smart energy management systems (EMS), solar panels and charging stations for guests we increase the available power at your location. And you always keep insight into your usage.
sol.label: The solution
sol.h2: Four building blocks, one system at your location
sol.intro: We combine storage, control, self-generation and charging infrastructure into one whole. That gives you more power from the connection you already have, without waiting for grid reinforcement.
sol.c1p: A battery absorbs your peaks and supplies power when you need it.
sol.c2p: The energy management system learns your consumption profile and controls battery, solar and chargers in real time. Everything comes together in one dashboard.
sol.c3p: Your own generation on the roof, directly linked to storage and consumption. That way you use your own power at the moment you need it.
sol.c4p: From 22 kW AC to fast chargers. Guests charge on stored energy, with dynamic load management, so your connection is not strained.
reg.label: Prepared for what is coming
reg.h2: Stay compliant with EPBD IV and GACS
reg.intro: We also prepare you for what is coming. So you keep complying with the mandatory charging infrastructure (EPBD IV) and with GACS, the regulation for building automation. It currently applies to larger buildings, and from 2030 also to smaller hotels.
reg.e1p: Charging infrastructure at buildings with parking spaces has been regulated in the Netherlands since 29 May 2026. For existing hotels the requirements follow from 1 January 2027.
reg.e1i1: New build and major renovation, from 29 May 2026: with more than 5 parking spaces at least 1 charging point per 5 spaces, plus pre-cabling for 50%.
reg.e1i2: Existing hotels with more than 20 parking spaces, from 1 January 2027: at least 1 charging point per 10 spaces, or ducting for half of the spaces.
reg.e1i3: Grid congestion is not an exemption. With battery, smart control and load balancing you install the charging points without costly grid reinforcement.
reg.e1src: Source: EPBD IV: mandatory charging infrastructure for hotels
reg.e2p: A building automation and control system measures, analyses and controls your climate installations. It is not a product in a box, but a layer on top of your existing installations.
reg.e2i1: Mandatory since 1 January 2026 for non-residential buildings with a heating or air conditioning system above 290 kW. With a ballroom, kitchen and pool a hotel reaches that threshold quickly.
reg.e2i2: From 1 January 2028 automatic lighting control per zone becomes mandatory above 290 kW.
reg.e2i3: From 1 January 2030 the threshold drops to 70 kW. From then on GACS also applies to mid-sized hotels.
reg.e2src: Source: GACS obligation for hotels
reg.e3p: Whoever invests in charging stations and control now, is not only compliant later, but also lowers energy costs and makes the hotel more attractive to guests with an electric car.
aan.label: Our approach
aan.h2: System design based on the real data of your location
aan.intro: We do not sell you a system that looks good on paper and shows nice figures. We look at the real data of your location to understand what is needed.
aan.c1p: We map your consumption, peaks and available space and base the design on that. No standard package, but a system that fits your location.
aan.c2p: That is how we give you tailored advice. We also think along about budgeting and allocating energy: which installation gets which power, and at what moment.
aan.c3p: Through an integration with your PMS we turn your energy into additional revenue, with upsell products for your guests. This integration is currently being developed.
aan.c4p: Delivered turnkey, with warranty and 24/7 monitoring. We spot deviations first and intervene, without you having to think about it.
vi.label: Vertically integrated
vi.h2: One point of contact for the whole solution
vi.intro: No separate parties you have to bring together yourself. We design and supply, our technical partner Stroomlijnen installs and maintains.
vi.p: And we map the available energy at your location. So you know exactly what you have, what you can allocate and where there is room to grow.
vi.c3t: One dashboard for storage, solar and charging
vi.c4t: Advice on subsidies and tax schemes
team.label: For hoteliers, by hoteliers
team.h2: We speak the language of hospitality
team.intro: Lemnion was founded by two hoteliers. We know the peaks around breakfast and evening, the kitchen, the pool and what your guests expect. Through the Hotel Leaders Network and Hotelprofessionals we have direct contact with the industry.
team.p1p: Hotelschool The Hague · Hilton Amsterdam. Built the largest hospitality network in the Netherlands and now helps hotels with the energy transition.
team.p2p: Hotelschool The Hague · Hilton. Expert in hospitality operations and business development, turning energy into clear choices for hoteliers.
ep.cta.h2: Curious what is possible at your location?
ep.cta.p: In a 20 minute introduction we look at your consumption, your connection and your plans. You get a concrete picture of what is needed, what it delivers and where you can use subsidies. Without obligation.
